citation.title: Differences in protein expression, at the basal state and at 2 h of insulin infusion, in muscle biopsies from healthy Arab men with low or high insulin sensitivity

reported.what: fasting and 2 h glucose of the high (n=8) and low (n=8) insulin sensitivity groups, mean ± SD (Table 1 footnote: Average ± SD)
M value of the two groups, mean ± SD (the selection variable)

detail: The 16 men are the extreme M-value tails (M >13 and M <=6) of 60 healthy men and no pooled or unselected group is reported, so the two arms differ by a measurement the model cannot be told apart by; the clamp gives only an insulin infusion rate and no plasma insulin.
